prompt: What is the main advantage of the generator expression `(x*x for x in range(10))` over the list comprehension `[x*x for x in range(10)]`?
explanation: Generator expressions yield one item at a time instead of building the whole sequence in memory.

options.text: It runs with better asymptotic time complexity
It's lazy and memory-friendly, not materializing all items at once
It's the only way to filter items with `if`
